title: 2030 — First swarm hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses
definition: 2030 milestone on the Ocean Cleanup Bot Swarms roadmap.
description:
First swarm hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses, farms and sorting systems construction sites.

What must be true first: the collector bots results have to replicate outside the lab, swarm logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and gyre navigation operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed collector bots demonstrations, swarm logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting gyre navigation uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

t: Ocean Cleanup Bot Swarms Systems Simulator
title: Ocean Cleanup Bot Swarms Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Ocean Cleanup Bot Swarms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Ocean Cleanup Bot Swarms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 94713 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where collector bots monitoring, swarm logistics redundancy, or gyre navigation maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Ocean Cleanup Bot Swarms Master Roadmap
title: Ocean Cleanup Bot Swarms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Ocean Cleanup Bot Swarms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Ocean Cleanup Bot Swarms — robot swarms harvesting ocean plastic.

Phase 1 — Prove (collector bots): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (swarm logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (gyre navigation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (sorting systems): swarm hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and oceans-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
